task: Implement the M0-M1 slice of the Proof-or-Stop agent-drivability roadmap plus minimal #6 scope-plan dispatch and checklist_add ledger-sync guidance so INIT and PLAN guidance route agents to the right preflight, reviewer, and ledger commands.
outcome: After this story, INIT story guidance routes through init_preflight, story-level scope-plan reviewers can be dispatched to write scope_check_save evidence, and checklist_add on ledger-backed stories warns agents to synchronize milestone ledger coverage without auto-creating evidence.
facts: The confirmed failure mode is discoverability/routing, not weak gate semantics.
init_preflight already exists and aggregates INIT_CHECK prerequisites read-only.
Current session_brief/next and global help still route directly to story_advance INIT_CHECK.
Current lattice dispatch rejects story-level lattice-review-scope-plan without itemId, which is the documented #6 blocker.

checklist_add can add checklist items to a story that already has milestone-ledger.json while only telling the agent to run story_review, leaving milestone_status to project an incomplete ledger until someone manually notices.
This story includes the minimal #6 dispatch unblocker and the small checklist_add ledger-sync hint because both prevent repeat agent rediscovery of known planning dead ends.
constraints: Do not weaken dual INIT reviewer, scope anti-expansion, verificationIntent, review, TEST, DONE, or production-readiness gates.
Do not auto-run commands or write evidence from init_preflight/session_brief/help surfaces.
Do not let the main implementation agent self-sign scope_check_save.
Do not let checklist_add auto-create milestone rows or infer milestone claims from checklist prose.
Keep changes scoped to INIT routing, minimal story-level scope-plan dispatch, and checklist_add ledger-sync guidance.
Story operations must go through lattice commands, not direct JSON edits.
Remote publish is out of scope.
unknowns: Which existing focused test file is the smallest stable home for M1 routing assertions.
Whether the M0 baseline contract should live only in the decision doc or also in a small machine-readable test fixture.
Whether existing dispatch tests already cover story-level INIT reviewers and item-scoped reviewers enough to extend safely.
Whether checklist_add has a central output helper or needs a direct handler-level hint after writes.
